4f94d76c71b97fa5.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,  you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

Key Roles and Responsibilities:


● Ecosystem collaboration: Self-starter to identify and collaborate with ecosystem players to discover and co-build products for the market (Fintechs, Banks, Partners,etc)
● Map, develop and drive strong working relationships with key influencers for the assigned banks. It should include mapping the various teams in the assigned banks thoroughly and plot them out to ans organogram of the banks.
● Deliver against volume, revenue, penetration and growth targets for the identified and assigned partner banks.
● Identifying partnership opportunities within existing/new banking relationships.
● Design banking partnerships as a distribution channel for local payments acquiring business, with an aim to scale while owning P&L of north headquartered banks.
● Liaising with other cross-functional teams like Solutions, Product etc. to ensure that we deliver on required customizations by sizing up the opportunity and getting it prioritized appropriately
● Understand subvention and other applicable models and drive Razorpay’s GTM strategy via bank-led route.
● Identify and pitch newer use cases such as Omnichannel (offline+online), Cross border payments, PPI, other solutions - via Bank partnership channel.
● Develop implementation plan across alliance life cycle for the assigned portfolio of banks/PSPs
● Define and own metrics for monitoring the performance & the effectiveness of existing alliances
● Facilitate seamless onboarding of Razorpay as a Vendor / Customer in the bank’s ecosystem as well as ensure set-up on system and its complete alignment across departments
● Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including leadership, strategy, marketing, and design teams to ensure seamless execution of business launch and scale-up
● Ecosystem collaboration: Self-starter to identify and collaborate with ecosystem players to discover and co-build products for the market (Fintechs, Banks, Partners, etc)

● Ensuring that the engagements are well formalized with the partner banks by way of agreement(s) and agreed base rates and mark-ups applicable, if any. Also taking care of internal closure with cross-functional departments like Legal, Finance etc.


Mandatory Qualifications:


● 2-3 years of overall experience of which 4+ years in Merchant acquiring space with either Payment Gateways, Networks, Banks or Fintech companies.
● Established and existing network with banks (public + private) and networks in the North Region.
● High energy team player with willingness to learn and adapt quickly
● Energetic self-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment with proven track record of creating and executing partnerships/alliances that drive measurable business results
● Ability to run technical conversations with the bank to drive problem discovery and primary-level solutioning
● Analytical capability to deal with the technical, contractual and financial aspects of the business.
● Ability to effectively think strategically and influence cross-functional teams, such as Solutions, Product, Operations to drive outsized business outcomes
● Willingness to travel regionally to meet with banks/large merchants acquired through the banking partners

Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.
The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

Mission
Turn clear product direction into exceptional, implementation-ready product experiences.
This role exists to dramatically increase the speed at which product ideas become real. You will work directly with the Head of Product to take written product specifications, workflow descriptions, existing product patterns, screenshots, and rough Figma-frame descriptions and turn them into polished, coherent, buildable designs.
This is a highly execution-oriented design role. We are looking for someone who can move quickly from concept to detailed UI without requiring constant direction or extensive design ceremonies.

What You’ll Own
• 
Translate detailed product specifications into high-quality Figma designs.
• 
Design workflows for complex command-and-control and operational software.
• 
Take rough frame descriptions and independently determine layout, hierarchy, interaction details, and edge cases.
• 
Build and maintain reusable Figma components and patterns.
• 
Maintain consistency across the product as new capabilities are introduced.
• 
Work closely with engineering to ensure designs are understood and implementable.
• 
Review implemented functionality and identify discrepancies between design intent and the built product.
• 
Help evolve the overall UX architecture of Legion as the product expands.
• 
Rapidly iterate based on operator, engineering, and customer feedback.
• 
Fill in reasonable UX details independently rather than requiring every interaction to be explicitly specified.

What Great Looks Like
You receive a well-written product spec and a description of the required Figma frames.
You understand the intent quickly.
You identify the handful of questions that actually matter.
Then you disappear for a period of focused work and come back with something substantially better than what was described.
The resulting Figma should be clear enough that engineering can build from it, polished enough to show a customer, and thoughtful enough that the Head of Product does not need to design every interaction personally.

The Person We’re Looking For
You are an unusually strong individual contributor.
You are fast.
You have excellent product judgment and visual judgment.
You are comfortable designing dense, information-rich software rather than only simple consumer applications.
You enjoy receiving strong product direction and turning it into an excellent finished experience.
You are comfortable making decisions independently when requirements do not specify every detail.
You can distinguish between a product question that requires escalation and a design detail that you should simply solve.
You communicate clearly with engineers and product leaders.
You care about craft, but you do not allow perfectionism to slow down execution.

Particularly Valuable Experience
Experience with any of the following would be especially valuable:
• 
Command-and-control systems
• 
Aerospace or defense software
• 
Robotics or autonomous systems
• 
Geospatial interfaces
• 
Mission planning software
• 
Industrial or operational software
• 
Gaming interfaces
• 
Complex dashboards
• 
Design systems
• 
Human-machine interfaces
• 
Software used in time-sensitive or safety-critical environments

What This Role Is Not
This is not primarily a branding role.
It is not primarily a UX research role.
It is not a role centered around workshops, design-thinking exercises, or producing large amounts of process documentation.
Those capabilities can be useful, but the core requirement is simple:

You must be exceptionally good at turning product intent into excellent software designs quickly.
Success After 6 Months
• 
Product specifications routinely move into Figma without the Head of Product personally designing them.
• 
Engineering receives clearer and more complete designs.
• 
Legion has stronger UX consistency across features.
• 
Design iteration cycles become significantly faster.
• 
The Head of Product spends more time on strategy, customers, and product decisions, and less time producing individual screens.

ITAR requirement
To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
Swarm Aero is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or disability.

What We Offer
• 
Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company
• 
Competitive base salary commensurate with experience
• 
Medical, dental, vision, and 401k
• 
PTO and paid sick leave
• 
Monthly wellness stipend
• 
Daily catered lunch (office)
• 
Paid parental leave
• 
Direct impact on a critical national security mission
• 
A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems
Compensation: $170K – $220K • Offers Equity

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

About the Role

We are looking for an Account Executive to join our Sales and Go-to-Market team. This role is based in the greater Southern CA area, reporting to the Regional Director. You will be part of a global group of professionals passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. By demonstrating the power and agility of cloud transformation, you will help cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• 

Build relationships with important internal and customer stakeholders, including c-suite decision-makers

• 

Create a long-term account strategy aligned with customer goals

• 

Collaborate with internal teams to meet customer needs and contribute to comprehensive account planning

• 

Act as a trusted advisor by understanding client businesses and aligning technical solutions with their strategic goals

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• 

You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

• 

You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• 

You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

• 

You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to help define and deliver Cribl security product experience. You will design for security practitioners across detection, alerting, investigation, triage, search, threat coverage, telemetry, and AI-assisted workflows.

This role requires a genuine security background and the ability to turn complex SOC workflows into clear, trustworthy experiences. You will partner with Product, Engineering, UX Research, and other designers to create a cohesive experience that works seamlessly with our other products across the entire Cribl platform.

• Lead end-to-end design from problem framing and research through interaction design, prototyping, validation, and implementation.

• Communicate design rationale, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical partners.

 About the Role

We are looking for an industry mentor to deliver a 24-hour, mentor-led programme in AI Assisted Data Analytics with Power BI. The mentor will guide learners from analytics fundamentals through data preparation, modeling, DAX, interactive dashboards, AI-assisted analysis, and report publishing. The role calls for clear instruction, practical demonstrations, and patient support for learners who may be new to Power BI and AI tools.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building business reports in Power BI and can use AI responsibly to support analytical questions, transformations, DAX development, visual selection, and insight communication. The mentor should be comfortable teaching through business datasets, guided exercises, assessments, and scenario-based problem solving.

Key Responsibilities

• Deliver interactive sessions and guided practical exercises across all six programme modules within the proposed

• Explain analytics concepts, the analytics lifecycle, business intelligence, data quality, responsible AI, and effective prompt engineering in accessible terms.

• Demonstrate connections to Excel, CSV, and SQL sources; guide learners through Power Query profiling, cleaning, transformations, and merge and append operations.

• Help learners design relationships and star schemas and develop calculated columns, DAX measures, KPIs, and introductory time intelligence calculations.

• Coach learners in building clear interactive dashboards using charts, matrices, slicers, filters, drill-down, drill-through, bookmarks, and tooltips.

• Demonstrate relevant Power BI AI capabilities, including Key Influencers, Decomposition Tree, Smart Narrative, Q&A, forecasting basics, and Copilot where available.

• Guide learners through publishing to Power BI Service, workspaces and apps, sharing, scheduled refresh, basic row-level security, governance, and performance practices.

• Conduct pre- and post-assessments, quizzes, doubt-clearing discussions, and practical reviews; monitor progress and provide actionable feedback.

• Prepare or adapt sample datasets, lab instructions, exercises, and evaluation materials; document learner outcomes and contribute to the consolidated trainer performance report.

Required Skills and Qualifications

Technical Skills

• Strong practical knowledge of Power BI Desktop, Power Query, data modeling, DAX, and dashboard design.

• Experience connecting and preparing Excel, CSV, and SQL data, including handling missing or duplicate records and assessing data quality.

• Working knowledge of Power BI Service, publishing, workspaces, scheduled refresh, sharing, and basic row-level security.

• Ability to explain and validate AI-assisted analysis and use Power BI AI features appropriately, with awareness of responsible AI and data privacy.

• Ability to translate business questions into meaningful measures, visualizations, and executive-ready insights.

Experience

Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in data analytics or business intelligence using Power BI, including practical report and dashboard development. Experience mentoring or training learners is an advantage.

Soft Skills

• Clear technical communication and the ability to teach beginners through examples and live demonstrations.

• Patient, learner-friendly approach to resolving questions and troubleshooting exercises.

• Strong facilitation, assessment, feedback, and progress reporting skills.

• Ability to manage session time and collaborate with programme stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field.

• Experience delivering instructor-led or industry training in analytics or Power BI.

• Exposure to Power BI Copilot and enterprise reporting environments, subject to feature availability.

Key Attributes We Are Looking For

• Passion for mentoring and helping learners build practical confidence.

• Sound analytical judgment and attention to data accuracy.

• An approachable style and willingness to adapt explanations to different skill levels.

• A practical focus on business outcomes, clear reporting, and responsible use of AI.

4f7092d44ceb372d.description: Growth Product Manager Location: Mumbai, India The role in one line Own the revenue we make from artists and small promoters who buy from us without ever speaking to a salesperson. Context The Company' PRO sells advertising and reach to promoters, venues, festivals and ticketing companies through a sales team. Alongside that, a long tail of artists and small promoters buys campaigns directly, self-serve, worldwide. That business already generates several million dollars a year and nobody owns it. It sits between operations, product and marketing. We're making it a line with a number and one person accountable for it. Support for these customers already runs from our India office, so the customers are already ours to serve; what's missing is someone running the funnel. This is not a feature-shipping product role. You carry a revenue and retention number. What you'll own The full self-serve funnel end to end: acquisition, signup, activation, first spend, repeat spend. The funnel surfaces: pricing pages, onboarding, activation messaging, the first-spend flow. You ship these directly with dedicated engineering capacity. Paid acquisition to reach artists who don't know we exist, with your own budget. The cohort picture: what share of artists who spend once spend again within 90 days, and why the rest don't. What you're measured on Self-serve revenue. Repeat-spend rate. Cost per acquired spender, against lifetime value. Volume of accounts crossing the $1,000/year threshold, at which point they surface to an account executive. Who we're looking for A marketer who can ship, more than a product manager who can market. Required: You have personally carried a revenue target on a self-serve funnel. Product-led SaaS, consumer subscription, e-commerce the sector matters less than the fact that nobody was there to blame the sales team. You read cohorts instinctively. Given a signup number, your first question is about the second purchase. You have run paid acquisition with your own budget and know what it cost you to acquire a paying customer. You are comfortable shipping pricing and packaging changes, not only onboarding flows. You can work with engineers directly and specify what you need without a layer in between. Not required: Music industry experience. This is a low-ticket global funnel; the mechanics transfer from e-commerce or SaaS faster than an industry background transfers into analytics. .

4f23f8c926ad5e8f.description: Ameriprise Financial is hiring a Financial Analyst Intern in Thiruvananthapuram. This is a hands-on, mentor-led BFSI internship built for students and 2026 freshers who want real exposure to how a asset management actually runs its numbers not a certificate-only programme. About the role As a Financial Analyst Intern at Ameriprise Financial, your core focus will be variance analysis, MIS reporting and business performance tracking. You will be attached to a named mentor, join the team's daily stand-ups and reviews, and be trusted with work that genuinely matters rather than filing and formatting. Questions are encouraged, mistakes are treated as teaching moments, and your output is reviewed properly so you actually improve. What you'll do day to day Support variance analysis, MIS reporting and business performance tracking alongside the core asset management team Work in Excel and the company's internal systems on live financial data Prepare schedules, reconciliations and reports that go to real reviewers Research companies, customers, products or regulations as the work demands Turn your analysis into clear notes and decks for senior stakeholders Follow the documentation and control standards a regulated business requires Take part in reviews, ask questions and act on the feedback you receive Skills you'll build You will build practical, demonstrable experience in Financial Analysis, Advanced Excel, MIS Reporting, Variance Analysis, SQL Basics, Power BI / Tableau, Forecasting, Business Partnering, Presentation Skills, Problem Solving the exact toolkit that separates a hireable finance fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, numerical comfort and care with detail matter far more here than a polished rsum, and every one of these skills is taught on the job. Who should apply Students in their final year or recent graduates from B.Com/BBA/MBA (Finance)/B.Tech with a finance interest based in or willing to work from Thiruvananthapuram. You should be comfortable with numbers, willing to learn Financial Analysis, Advanced Excel, MIS Reporting, and able to communicate clearly in writing. Relevant coursework, certifications (NISM, CFA L1, GST, Tally) or a strong academic record in Financial Analysis will strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory. Internship details This is a 3-month internship in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, with a stipend of 39,000 per month. You will be given a defined project so that you leave with an automated MIS dashboard the team keeps using. Working hours follow the team's normal business hours and the internship includes a certificate on successful completion. You will finish this internship able to read a set of financial statements with confidence, work comfortably in Excel at speed, and explain exactly how your work fed a real business decision. Strong performers are considered for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) and a full-time role. How to apply Click Apply Now. If you are not logged in you will be asked to sign in and register first, after which you will be taken to Ameriprise Financial's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and seats for this Financial Analysis-focused internship are limited, so apply early. Responsibilities: Support variance analysis, MIS reporting and business performance tracking alongside the core asset management team; Work in Excel and internal systems on live financial data; Prepare schedules, reconciliations and reports for senior review; Research companies, customers, products or regulations as required; Present analysis clearly in notes and decks for stakeholders; Follow documentation and control standards required in a regulated business. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed B.Com/BBA/MBA (Finance)/B.Tech with a finance interest 2026 freshers & final-year students welcome; Working knowledge of Financial Analysis, Advanced Excel, MIS Reporting (or a genuine willingness to learn them); Strong numerical ability and comfort working in MS Excel; Care with detail and the discipline to document work properly; Clear written and verbal communication in English; Based in or willing to work from Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. .
